Cerne is a modern, easy-to-learn and open-source systems programming language

What is Cerne?


Cerne is a modern, open-source systems programming language whose main goal is to provide safety and efficiency without sacrificing easy of use.
It's also accompanied by a package manager, intuitive build system and a powerful standard library, which makes it a good choice for general use as well.
